decisive_items: Nailfold examination showed dilated capillary loops, capillary dropout, and ragged cuticles
Elevated serum IFN-β levels (8 pg/mL, normal ≤2 pg/mL)
response.rationale: The vignette describes a photosensitive eruption with poikiloderma, Gottron-like papules, nailfold capillary changes, elevated IFN-β, and anti-TIF-1γ antibodies, all classic for juvenile dermatomyositis. Only one candidate was supplied, so it is the clear champion.
